component.name: Snip for COSMIC™
component.summary: Snip a region of the screen and annotate it

description.p: Select any region of the screen - on one monitor or across several - then mark it up and copy or save it. Made for the COSMIC™ desktop; it is not an official COSMIC application.
The selection is drawn by the desktop's own screenshot portal, the same one the system screenshot tool uses. The editor adds:

ul.li: Pen, highlighter, arrow and rectangle tools
Six colours and adjustable stroke widths, remembered for the next snip
Undo, and keyboard shortcuts for every tool
Copy to the clipboard at full resolution, or save as PNG

description.p: Based on CosmicSnip by itssoup, rewritten in Rust on libcosmic.
Rewritten in Rust on libcosmic, under a new name and application ID.

ul.li: The desktop's screenshot portal draws the selection, so a snip can span monitors
A copy stays on the clipboard after the editor has closed
The colour and stroke widths are remembered between snips

description.p: The last release of the original Python CosmicSnip.
First stable release of the original Python CosmicSnip.
Initial release of the original Python CosmicSnip.
